verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Apify running automated Actors that use Playwright, Puppeteer, or Selenium, plus base Docker images. These are building blocks for headless automation. Nothing in the pack documents a managed remote browser that a developer can open and drive interactively or manually, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can access a managed remote browser sandbox for interactive, manual browsing workflows
